title: KVisual Settngs
description: This is an best visual mod ever! This mod adds too much visual settings
body:
KVisual Settings is a client-side Minecraft modification for the 1.20.1 game version that is designed to provide a better visual experience by allowing players to use customizable visual side of Minecraft!


✨ Features

🎥 Camera Settings
![Caera Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/388b73537e0b315ccec0c0e0270c782f8773a129_0.webp)
Extra FOV - Increase the field of view beyond the regular vanilla field of view limit for a much larger view.

Toggle View Bobbing Independently - Control whether you want to use walking bobbing (regardless of whether you are using vanilla bobbing or not) independently from other movement animations.

Damage Tilt - When you take damage, you can disable or adjust the tilt of the screen to make the world appear steadier.

💡 Glow System
![Glow settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4baaf93e00697748aa082d9f3b8fddb80fee551.png)
Select Glowing Entities - Make any entity in the world (mobs, players, items, etc.) glow by selecting them to glow.

Choose Your Glow Colors - There are many different colors you can choose to make an entity glow.

Save and Import Your Glow Settings - You can save your specific glow settings into a JSON file, which allows you to share your glow settings with others and/or download and use their glow settings.

You can configure and manage your glow settings through the easy-to-use in-game graphical interface.

🛠️ Configuration

JSON Export - Export your current glow assignments and colors to a JSON file. This will be saved into the .minecraft/kvisual/glow directory. You can edit this file manually or share it with others.
